body: claimed: UMA · 2026-11-12T04:15Z · branch issue/1036-bore-entry (mkinney fork, synced at v0.18.0) · plan: reproduce first: a milled Bore with a non-centre-cutting cutter and nothing drilled ahead; if it plunges, refuse by name via the same prior-stock read as #992's thread_entry (raise to P0 on confirmation); if it can't, pin that it can't

Reproduced on main (3e9b8ae1, fork synced at v0.18.0): **the plunge does not happen** - already done by the M11.3 centre-cutting law, 874507a8 (generate lays `tool.center_cutting` over the Bore's links, `lk.approach.center_cutting`) and 515525c4 (every planar-ladder descent asks it: `machining2d::descent::plan_core`, `plunge_law::guard` in `feed_down`). The Bore ride is a planar ladder (`run_levels`), so it is covered.

Evidence (solid 60x60x20 block, nothing drilled, 8 mm end mill with `center_cutting: false`):
- Ø20 hole: generates; each rung is entered by a zig-zag ramp along the radial sweep, note "entry: the tool is not centre-cutting and may not plunge into solid (the plunge arm) - ramp along the first cut instead"; the ring re-entries plunge only onto columns the sweep cut. `plunge_law::first_solid_plunge` finds no axial plunge into solid (it does find one on the centre-cutting cutter's path - unchanged).
- Ø9 hole (no helix, no ramp run): refused by name - "entry refused: the tool is not centre-cutting - the plunge arm, and no helix or ramp fits onto Z 15.000".

So no P0 and no #992-style prior-stock refusal: an end mill without centre teeth may ramp/helix in (a thread mill cannot, which is why #992 needed one). Pinned by `crates/app/tests/bore_entry.rs` (3 tests) in PR #1065 (test-only, `Refs #1036`); decision in `docs/decisions/1036-bore-entry.md`. Closing as already done (874507a8 / 515525c4).
